Name: Industrial Custom Picture Frames and Windows
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Content pack for Custom Picture Frames that adds several industrial themed picture frames and fake windows which you can fill with screenshots in-game
Description:
_Description:_

*   Content pack for Custom Picture Frames

*   Adds several industrial themed picture frames and fake windows

*   Take pictures in-game and display them on your walls!

*   If you like this you could buy me a [coffee](https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart)﻿ to show your support
_To start:_

1.  Extract this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started)﻿)

2.  Launch the game

3.  Buy picture frames at Robin's Carpenter shop

4.  Press f10 to start taking a picture to put in your frame, press f11 to switch between different frames, press f12 to take a picture

5.  Put the frame on your wall and hover over it and press f11 until you find the picture you want
_Tips and tricks_

*   To get the picture frames at different heights you can use [Furniture Adjustment](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10213)

*   The CustomPictureFrames mod save your images whether you save the day or not

*   Since each save file has it's own album in the "CustomPictureFrames" folder you can try making your own art and putting it in the folder
